payload.reason: The evidence indicates that pre-trained embeddings significantly enhance the performance of sequence tagging models by providing context-sensitive representations that are not captured by task-specific RNNs alone.

claims.text: Not having access to pre-trained embeddings would likely result in lower performance in sequence tagging tasks, as demonstrated by experiments showing a drop in F1 scores when task-specific RNNs were used without LM embeddings.
Pre-trained embeddings improve the model's ability to encode semantic and syntactic roles, which are crucial for accurate predictions in NLP tasks.

The absence of pre-trained embeddings would mean relying solely on limited labeled data, which has been shown to yield inferior results compared to models utilizing larger, unlabeled corpora for training.
